confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge of Jakarta price levels, not checked against live listings. Restaurant and warung anchors are the most reliable. Hotel and hostel anchors vary widely by district and season, so they are less certain. Cocktail and wine are estimated from the local beer-to-bar and restaurant price relationship, with imported wine adding uncertainty. FX value taken from the RBA exchange-rates page as surfaced in search results; the underlying CSV was not opened.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on Southeast Asian capital and major-city restaurant, bar and accommodation pricing (e.g., Bangkok, Manila, Kuala Lumpur), adjusted to Jakarta's lower general price level and Indonesian local-currency cost structure.
